changes.new: Nonzero locally algebraic vectors first imply the distinct-weight almost-de-Rham condition by VI.5.1. Theorem VI.6.13, printed p450, then gives the stronger implication that D is de Rham: its contrapositive says Pi_lalg is zero when D is not de Rham. Its local proof uses VI.6.12 and VI.4.9. This forward step is required before applying VI.6.30 and VI.6.50 in their de-Rham domain. Conversely, VI.6.18 supplies nonvanishing for the de-Rham representation with distinct weights.
